name: chinese-converter
title: Chinese Converter
description: Convert number input into Chinese formatted text, including uppercase RMB amount text.
author: tofrankie

commands.name: convert-to-rmb
commands.title: Convert to RMB
commands.description: Convert number input to uppercase Chinese RMB text.

preferences.name: decimalPlaces
preferences.title: Decimal Places
preferences.description: For 1.2345 with 2 digits, keep 1.23 before conversion.

preferences.name: roundingMode
preferences.title: Extra Decimal Handling
preferences.description: For 1.235 with 2 digits, Round gives 1.24 and Truncate gives 1.23.

preferences.name: unOmitYuan
preferences.title: Always Show Yuan (元)
preferences.description: For number input like 0.32, show 零元叁角贰分 instead of 叁角贰分.
preferences.label: Always Show Yuan (元)

preferences.name: forceZheng
preferences.title: Append 整 Automatically
preferences.description: For number input like 1, show 壹元整 instead of 壹元.
preferences.label: Append 整 Automatically

preferences.name: moneyPrefix
preferences.title: Custom Prefix Text
preferences.description: For number input like 0.32 with prefix 人民币, show 人民币零元叁角贰分 instead of 零元叁角贰分.
